Asks any web API for data, or sends it some: a GET, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE, the answer put on each item, JSON read as such. An answer not 2xx fails the item, the answer on it still.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `http.request` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Method (`method`) | text | no | `GET` | One of `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`. |
| URL (`url`) | text | yes |  | https://… and any {{ field }}, e.g. https://api.example.com/markets/{{ id }}. A key belongs in a credential, below: sharing the workflow keeps the URL. |
| Query (`query`) | list of text | no |  | name=value, one per line, added to the URL, each encoded for you: q={{ question }}. |
| Headers (`headers`) | list of text | no |  | Name: value, one per line, e.g. Accept: application/json. |
| Body (`body`) | text | no |  | Sent with the request, empty for none. As json, a {{ }} inside quotes is written as text, and anywhere else as JSON: {"question": "{{ question }}", "item": {{ item }}}. |
| Body as (`bodyAs`) | text | no | `json` | json, checked as such; form, name=value&… with each value encoded; or text as it is. Its Content-Type, unless Headers give one. One of `json`, `form`, `text`. |
| Credential (`credential`) | one of your credentials: [HTTP header](/docs/reference/credential-types/#http-header) or [Bearer token](/docs/reference/credential-types/#bearer-token) or [Username and password](/docs/reference/credential-types/#username-and-password) or [Key in the URL](/docs/reference/credential-types/#key-in-the-url) | no |  | Optional. A header, a bearer token, a username and password, or a key in the URL, from your Credentials page. Personal: sharing the workflow leaves it out. |
| Send (`send`) | text | no | `each` | each: a request for each item, up to 100 a run unless an admin says otherwise. once: one request with the first item's values, its answer on every item. One of `each`, `once`. |
| Read the answer as (`response`) | text | no | `auto` | auto: JSON when it says it is, text otherwise. json: JSON, failing the item if it is not. One of `auto`, `json`, `text`. |
| Answer field (`field`) | text | no | `response` | Where the answer goes on the item. |
| Timeout (`timeout`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `10s` | How long a request may take, redirects and all; at most a minute. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `response` under the name **Answer field** (`field`) gives. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `response` | object | The answer. |
| `response.status` | number | Its status, like 200. |
| `response.headers` | anything | Its headers, by name in lower case, like content-type; one given twice has its values joined by commas. |
| `response.body` | anything | Its body: what the JSON holds, read, or else the text. |
